claude_proposed_widenings.name: SpeciesTraitRecord + passive_modifier mechanics family
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: UnitRecord has no 'species_trait' kind. ClassFeatureRecord requires activationCost/resource/resetCadence — all inapplicable to a permanently-on passive trait. A new top-level record type and a 'passive_modifier' (or 'passive_grant') mechanics family are needed to host species traits that are always-on with no activation.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Your Hit Point maximum increases by 1, and it increases by 1 again whenever you gain a level.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: modify_max_hp effect in ClassFeatureEffect (or species-trait equivalent)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The v4 atom 'modify_max_hp' exists in the taxonomy and TAXONOMY §12 notes it covers Dwarven Toughness, but ClassFeatureEffect only allows GrantExtraActionEffect | HealHpEffect. A passive species-trait mechanics family would need to expose modify_max_hp as an allowed effect.
